admission.justification: A truthful state word and complete hover prevent the row from presenting inferred non-reporting lifecycle assumptions or omitted facts as an actual task event; the retired outside-attention priority is not promised.

applicability: The single task-state word and full hover of an Operations task row.
conditions: The word and mark come from the reporting lifecycle, or from the document when no lifecycle has reported an event.
Asking and blocked lifecycle states retain the developer-first band within task-state classification; removed gate, pickup and own-hosted-chat activity are not competing word inputs.
The whole-row hover keeps current document, lifecycle, progress, worktree and repository facts.
exclusions: Deriving a gate or lifecycle event from UI colour or a session state.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/rowState.test.ts: "says the most pressing fact as the one word"; dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/signals.test.tsx (8 tests); dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/admission.test.tsx: "renders ONE task entry per enclosureId: a bound lifecycle annotates the doc row, never duplicates it".

statement: An Operations row says its task’s own state as its one word; asking and blocked task states occupy the developer-first band, and every other current fact the row knows remains in the whole-row hover text.
